steps.purpose: After extracting the existing input package, verify official checkout and base/LoRA model hashes
Verify the real server datasets environment before model load
Regenerate paths for the actual server; generation does not run inference
Run only after prerequisites are met on an available authorized GPU

output_rule: AB and BA separate dirs; preserve stdout and raw results; compare against16 expected keys per order. Official reward evaluator skips invalid predictions, so its built-in denominator alone is insufficient; explicitly count missing/invalid attempts as0 and report them separately. Existing frozen scoring: tie0.5, missing/invalid0. Map AB/BA back to canonical candidate IDs, report each order separately and count order inconsistency; no post-label selection or unspecified combined-order accuracy.
server_dependencies_remaining: actual accessible GPU server and login
pinned official checkout and complete compatible CUDA/vLLM/flash-attn environment
actual Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct base model and PVC LoRA paths and hashes
server writable cache/output paths and measured VRAM/latency
real32 inference attempts and raw outputs including missing/invalid cases
